game.chess.name: Chess
game.chess.desc: The classic game of kings: develop your pieces, control the centre and mate the enemy king. Full rules including castling, en passant, promotion and every drawing rule.
game.chess.rule.1: White moves first. Each piece has its own movement pattern; pawns promote on the last rank and the king may castle once with a rook.
game.chess.rule.2: Win by checkmating the enemy king. Stalemate, insufficient material, threefold repetition and the fifty-move rule are draws.
game.chess.option.castling_hint: When off, the king may never move two squares and the rook never jumps over it.
game.chess.option.en_passant_hint: A pawn that has just advanced two squares can be captured as if it had moved one.
game.chess.option.fifty_move_hint: Fifty moves without a capture or a pawn move end the game in a draw.
game.chess.notation_hint: Click a piece to see its legal moves, then click a highlighted square. Captures are marked red.
game.chess.reason_stalemate: Stalemate: no legal move and no check.
game.chess.reason_insufficient_material: Draw: not enough material to force mate.
game.chess.error.unknown_action: This action does not belong to chess.
game.chess.error.illegal_move: That move is not legal in this position.
